name: Towel Pull-Up Bar Hang
description: The towel hang involves looping a thick towel over a pull-up bar and gripping the towel's fabric with both hands, then hanging from the bar using only the towel grip. The irregular surface of the towel challenges the fingers and hand to grip differently than a standard bar, building crush grip and finger flexor strength. It is a simple but effective tool for combat sports athletes, climbers, and those with standard grip limitations.

execution.starting_position: Loop a thick gym towel over a pull-up bar, with both ends hanging down. Grip one end in each hand.
execution.setup_instructions: Use a heavy-duty gym towel or gi jacket. Ensure the bar and towel can support your bodyweight safely.
steps: Step 1: Grasp the two ends of the towel firmly.
Step 2: Lift the feet off the ground, hanging from the towel.
Step 3: Hold the hang for the prescribed duration with the arms fully extended.
Step 4: Lower the feet and release.
common_mistakes: Gripping too close to the bar (reduces towel challenge)
safety_considerations: Ensure the towel is securely looped over the bar before hanging
Start with short holds — towel grip is very taxing
coaching_cues: Squeeze the towel — not the bar
